name: Duplicacy
description: Duplicacy Web using the saspus mini image. Backup sources should normally be mounted read-only, backup storage must be read/write for backup and prune operations, and restores should use a separate read/write target.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent Duplicacy Web configuration and machine ID. Back up this directory. Change the FAST pool name if your MOS appdata is stored elsewhere.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Transient Duplicacy cache. This directory can be safely recreated.

paths.name: Backup Storage - Example
paths.description: EXAMPLE: storage containing Duplicacy snapshots and chunks. EDIT this host path before use. It must be read/write so Duplicacy can backup, check, copy and prune. For SMB/NFS storage, mount the remote on MOS first and verify that the Duplicacy UID/GID can create and delete files.

paths.name: Backup Source - Example
paths.description: EXAMPLE INPUT: data to be backed up. Read-only is recommended and protects production data from accidental modification. Add additional source mounts as needed.

paths.name: Restore Target - Example
paths.description: EXAMPLE OUTPUT: dedicated destination for restores. Must be read/write. Restoring to a separate directory is recommended so restored data can be verified before replacing production files.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID used to run Duplicacy. MOS commonly uses UID 500. Change this if the mounted data belongs to another user.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used to run Duplicacy. MOS commonly uses GID 500. Change this to match the group permissions of your mounted data.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used by Duplicacy Web and scheduled jobs. Change this to your local timezone, for example Europe/Madrid.

variables.name: Duplicacy Web Version
variables.description: Duplicacy Web version downloaded by the mini image. Stable is recommended.
